candidates.title: How The Clippers Lost 10 First-Round Draft Picks
candidates.description: The NBA has handed down the harshest salary cap penalty in league history. The Los Angeles Clippers forfeit their next five first-round draft picks, pay a $30 million fine, and submit to five years of league monitoring, while owner Steve Ballmer is suspended for a full year. The findings describe a pattern of misconduct in which the Clippers routed off-court endorsement money to Kawhi Leonard through corporate partners, including a $28 million no-show deal from Aspiration, the green fintech whose co-founder is now serving 14 years for defrauding investors.
